properties.name: Wagamama
properties.popup_body:
Inspired by busy, bustling ramen bars + Japanese market streets our chefs cook up authentic, tasty food to fuel your day. from hearty bowls of ramen to curries, fresh salads, donburi and traditionally inspired desserts there's something to fuel everyone's good.

wagamama also caters to the little ones with a kids menu and colouring activity sheets so the whole family can sip, slurp and smile together.

Location: Jubilee Place

properties.name: Smilepod
properties.popup_body:
Smilepod offers a new approach to dentistry, which takes away the irritations of traditional practices to make professional dental care truly accessible for the first time.

Being in the heart of the Jubilee place mall we welcome in both tourists and the hard working Canary Wharf community. This studio is also open on Saturdays by popular demand, allowing clients the flexibility they need for quality preventative and cosmetic dental care.

Jubilee Place is great for:

- Businessmen and women who don't have the time to visit their local dentist
- Emergency treatments: we provide on-the-day appointments as much as possible
- Cosmetic dentistry: whitening and straightening
- Lunchtime, evening and Saturday appointments
- A modern, professional dental environment

Location: Jubilee Place

properties.name: Café Brera
properties.popup_body: Café Brera Jubilee Place sits in the mezzanine level with beautiful tall glass ceilings hidden away from the hustle and bustle of the outside world. Here you will the perfect spot for a light and hearty lunch with a daily changing salad bar to envy, or stop over in the evenings and enjoy a cocktail or two with friends.

properties.name: Browns Tanning
properties.popup_body:
Browns Tanning is a tanning experience like no other. We offer 6 different Sunbeds including Red Light Therapy & Sensor Technology. 

You can book your sessions directly from our mobile app, just search for Browns Tanning on the App Store!
